runs.name: c11-reload-c10-pol-off-m0-al
runs.description: a stored configuration from before C11 (c10-pol-off-m0-al) loads with C11 off and runs on

evals.js: const S = await (await fetch('/experiments/tissue/configs/c10-pol-off-m0-al/snapshot.json')).json(); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, turn: moire.walls.params.turn, divFront: moire.walls.params.divFront, freeGlue: moire.walls.params.freeGlue, walls: moire.walls.params.on }
const T = await import('/experiments/tissue/tissue-lab.js'); return await T.measure({ every: 1 })
